/basics/accounting-basics/.title: Accounting Basics | RareBooks
/basics/accounting-basics/.description: This page explains the basic ideas of accounting with the example of a new business.

/basics/dashboard/.title: Dashboard | RareBooks
/basics/dashboard/.description: The dashboard shows a summary of your invoices, your cash flow, your profit, and your expenses.

/financial-reports/balance-sheet/.title: Balance Sheet | RareBooks
/financial-reports/balance-sheet/.description: The Balance Sheet shows the financial position of your company.

/financial-reports/general-ledger/.title: General Ledger | RareBooks
/financial-reports/general-ledger/.description: The General Ledger lists the accounting entries of your company.

/financial-reports/gst-reports/.title: GST Reports | RareBooks
/financial-reports/gst-reports/.description: RareBooks has two GST reports for companies in India:

/financial-reports/profit-and-loss-state.title: Profit and Loss Statement | RareBooks
/financial-reports/profit-and-loss-state.description: The Profit and Loss Statement shows the income, the expenses, and the profit or loss of your company in each period.

/financial-reports/reports/.title: Reports | RareBooks
/financial-reports/reports/.description: Reports show the data of your submitted documents in tables.

/financial-reports/trial-balance/.title: Trial Balance | RareBooks
/financial-reports/trial-balance/.description: A Trial Balance lists the balances of all your accounts for a period.

/getting-started/chart-of-accounts/.title: Chart of Accounts | RareBooks
/getting-started/chart-of-accounts/.description: The chart of accounts is the list of all the accounts of your company.

/getting-started/create-initial-entries/.title: Create Initial Entries | RareBooks
/getting-started/create-initial-entries/.description: Add some initial entries before you record transactions.

/getting-started/create-your-site/.title: Create Your Site | RareBooks
/getting-started/create-your-site/.description: RareBooks runs on your own site, such as yourcompany.rarebooks.cc.

/getting-started/getting-started-with-ra.title: Getting Started with RareBooks | RareBooks
/getting-started/getting-started-with-ra.description: RareBooks is an accounting app for small businesses.

/getting-started/import-wizard/.title: Import Wizard | RareBooks
/getting-started/import-wizard/.description: Use the Import Wizard to make many entries at once from a .csv file.

/getting-started/quick-search/.title: Quick Search | RareBooks
/getting-started/quick-search/.description: Quick Search finds documents, lists, reports, and pages in RareBooks.

/getting-started/roles-and-permissions/.title: Roles and Permissions | RareBooks
/getting-started/roles-and-permissions/.description: Roles control who can open RareBooks and what each user can do.

/getting-started/setup-opening-balances/.title: Setup Opening Balances | RareBooks
/getting-started/setup-opening-balances/.description: If you move from a different accounting system, enter the account balances from that system in RareBooks.

/getting-started/using-rarebooks-on-a-ph.title: Using RareBooks on a Phone | RareBooks
/getting-started/using-rarebooks-on-a-ph.description: RareBooks has a layout for phones.

/inventory/batches/.title: Batches | RareBooks
/inventory/batches/.description: A batch is a group of units of an item that you make or buy together, such as one production lot.

/inventory/introduction-to-inventory/.title: Introduction to Inventory | RareBooks
/inventory/introduction-to-inventory/.description: Inventory keeps track of the stock of your items.

/inventory/inventory-settings/.title: Inventory Settings | RareBooks
/inventory/inventory-settings/.description: The inventory settings set the default location, the stock accounts, and the inventory features that you use.

/inventory/purchase-receipt/.title: Purchase Receipt | RareBooks
/inventory/purchase-receipt/.description: A purchase receipt records the stock that you receive from a supplier.

/inventory/serial-number/.title: Serial Number | RareBooks
/inventory/serial-number/.description: A serial number identifies one unit of an item.

/inventory/shipment/.title: Shipment | RareBooks
/inventory/shipment/.description: A shipment records the stock that you deliver to a customer.

/inventory/stock-balance/.title: Stock Balance | RareBooks
/inventory/stock-balance/.description: The Stock Balance report shows the stock of each item at each location.

/inventory/stock-ledger/.title: Stock Ledger | RareBooks
/inventory/stock-ledger/.description: The Stock Ledger report shows the stock entries of your items.

/inventory/stock-movement/.title: Stock Movement | RareBooks
/inventory/stock-movement/.description: A stock movement records stock that moves into a location, out of a location, or between locations.

/masters/coupon-code/.title: Coupon Code | RareBooks
/masters/coupon-code/.description: A coupon code applies a pricing rule to a sales invoice.

/masters/items/.title: Items | RareBooks
/masters/items/.description: An item is a product or a service that you buy or sell.

/masters/master-data/.title: Master Data | RareBooks
/masters/master-data/.description: Master data is the set of records that your transactions use, such as customers, items, and tax templates.

/masters/party/.title: Party | RareBooks
/masters/party/.description: A party is a customer or a supplier.

/masters/price-list/.title: Price List | RareBooks
/masters/price-list/.description: A price list keeps a set of item rates.

/masters/pricing-rule/.title: Pricing Rule | RareBooks
/masters/pricing-rule/.description: A pricing rule changes the price of an item on a sales invoice when the invoice meets the conditions of the rule.

/masters/taxes/.title: Taxes | RareBooks
/masters/taxes/.description: A tax template has one or more tax rates and the accounts that get the tax.

/settings/customize-form/.title: Customize Form | RareBooks
/settings/customize-form/.description: Customize Form adds your own fields to the forms of RareBooks.

/settings/number-series/.title: Number Series | RareBooks
/settings/number-series/.description: A number series names documents with a prefix and a number, such as SINV-1001.

/settings/print-templates/.title: Print Templates | RareBooks
/settings/print-templates/.description: A print template sets how a document looks when you print it or save it as a PDF.

/settings/settings/.title: Settings | RareBooks
/settings/settings/.description: The settings control the company details, the features, and the defaults of RareBooks.

/transactions/discount-accounting/.title: Discount Accounting | RareBooks
/transactions/discount-accounting/.description: A discount decreases the price of an item on an invoice.

/transactions/journal-entries/.title: Journal Entries | RareBooks
/transactions/journal-entries/.description: A journal entry records a transaction directly in your accounts.

/transactions/lead/.title: Lead | RareBooks
/transactions/lead/.description: A lead is a person or a company that is interested in your products or services.

/transactions/loyalty-program/.title: Loyalty Program | RareBooks
/transactions/loyalty-program/.description: A loyalty program gives points to customers when they buy from you.

/transactions/multicurrency-accounting/.title: Multi Currency Invoicing | RareBooks
/transactions/multicurrency-accounting/.description: You can make a sales invoice or a purchase invoice in the currency of the customer or the supplier.

/transactions/payments/.title: Payments | RareBooks
/transactions/payments/.description: A payment records money that moves between you and a party.

/transactions/point-of-sale/.title: Point of Sale (POS) | RareBooks
/transactions/point-of-sale/.description: Use the POS to sell over the counter.

/transactions/purchase-invoice/.title: Purchase Invoices | RareBooks
/transactions/purchase-invoice/.description: A purchase invoice records a bill that a supplier sends you for goods or services.

/transactions/sales-invoice/.title: Sales Invoices | RareBooks
/transactions/sales-invoice/.description: A sales invoice is the bill that you send to a customer for a sale.

/transactions/sales-quotes/.title: Sales Quotes | RareBooks
/transactions/sales-quotes/.description: A sales quote is an offer of prices that you send to a customer or a lead.
